text: 周五（8月28日）欧市尾盘，英国10年期国债收益率涨3.3个基点，报5.063%，本周累涨0.3个基点，整体呈现出V形反转。 两年期英债收益率涨4.8个基点，报4.405%，北京时间22:00披露美联储主席沃什讲稿时微跌至4.351%刷新日低，随后反弹，本周累涨4.8个基点。 本周，30年期英债收益率累跌2.6个基点，50年期英债收益率累跌2.0个基点。 2/10年期英债收益率利差累跌4.495个基点，报+65.721个基点。
text_en: In late European trading on Friday (August 28), the yield on the UK 10-year gilt rose 3.3 basis points to 5.063%, up 0.3 basis point on the week, showing a V-shaped reversal overall. The 2-year gilt yield rose 4.8 basis points to 4.405%, dipping to a fresh daily low of 4.351% when Fed Chair Warsh's speech was released at 22:00 Beijing time before rebounding, up 4.8 basis points on the week. Over the week, the 30-year gilt yield fell 2.6 basis points and the 50-year gilt yield fell 2.0 basis points. The 2/10-year gilt yield spread fell 4.495 basis points to +65.721 basis points.
